notes.surfaces: void, ground and raise follow Flexoki bg, bg-2 and ui; line uses ui-2 so borders stay visible on raised surfaces.
notes.ink-3: Flexoki tx-3 (base-50) measures 2.0:1 (light) and 2.6:1 (dark) on bg; base-60 keeps the faint role at or above 3.5:1 while staying distinct from muted text.
notes.lume: Flexoki cyan is the links and active-states colour; the kepano accent hue (175) is cyan.
notes.human: Mounty uses one warm role for warnings and errors; Flexoki orange is the warning colour.
notes.emphasis: Mounty's bold, inline-code and graph-focus role maps to Flexoki orange.
notes.unresolved: Warm grey (tx-2) for unresolved graph nodes, drawn at 0.8 opacity.
notes.graph-line: The tx-3 step keeps graph links restrained, close to the default palette's link contrast.
